scientific_integrity: Cograph recognition is classical; this work claims the particular explicit polynomial, matching-deletion coefficient comparison, and crown minimal-deletion classification. Computations are reproducibility checks and independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: A coefficientwise comparison is asserted only when both bipartition classes have at least three vertices.
The maximal induced-cograph polynomial is proved for full matching deletion with equal classes, not arbitrary matching-deleted bicliques.
Exhaustive tests cover finite instances only; the all-parameter conclusions are proved by structural counting.
Published or unindexed equivalent statements under four-path transversal terminology remain a bibliographic priority risk.
title: Cograph-induced-subgraph profiles of matching-deleted bicliques
